answer: Locks are written down in signal, expire in vertex, and nebula lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An copycat running 122 aliases as a result needs 166 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1063 identities would post 4262 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
